title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Opinions on Further Fully Implementing the Judicial Responsibility System
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Implementation Opinions on Further Fully Implementing the Judicial Responsibility System

Fa Fa [2018] No. 23

To the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, comprehensively implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, strictly implement the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China, and ensure that the reform of the judicial responsibility system achieves tangible results, the Supreme People's Court has formulated the Implementation Opinions on Further Fully Implementing the Judicial Responsibility System. These Implementation Opinions are hereby issued to you. Please implement them earnestly in light of actual circumstances. Report any issues arising during implementation to the Supreme People's Court in a timely manner.

December 4, 2018

Implementation Opinions on Further Fully Implementing the Judicial Responsibility System

In order to thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, comprehensively implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, strictly implement the newly revised Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China, ensure that the reform of the judicial responsibility system achieves tangible results, effectively solve prominent problems such as inadequate implementation, imperfect supporting measures, and unsystematic promotion in some local reforms, and promote the overall improvement of judicial efficiency and judicial credibility, combined with the actual work of the people's courts, the following implementation opinions are put forward on further fully implementing the judicial responsibility system.

I. Unswervingly Advance the Reform of the Judicial Responsibility System

1. Deeply understand the significant significance of fully implementing the judicial responsibility system. Fully implementing the judicial responsibility system is a major reform task deployed by the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, an important measure for the people's courts to implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deepen the comprehensive and supporting reforms of the judicial system, and promote the modernization of the trial system and trial capabilities. It is of great significance for ensuring that the people's courts independently and impartially exercise their adjudicative power in accordance with the law, fully play their role in adjudicative functions, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for the coordinated promotion of the "Five-in-One" overall layout and the "Four Comprehensives" strategic layout. People's courts at all levels must always adhere to arming the mind, guiding practice, and promoting work with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, firmly establish the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," always achieve the "Two Upholds," resolutely ensure maintaining the core, absolute loyalty, listening to the Party's command, and having the courage to take responsibility, always maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core in thought, politics, and action, unswervingly deepen judicial system reform, fully implement the judicial responsibility system, and ensure that the various decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core regarding judicial system reform are implemented in the people's courts without any discount.

2. Firmly grasp the goal orientation and problem orientation of fully implementing the judicial responsibility system. Fully implementing the judicial responsibility system should adhere to the unity of goal orientation and problem orientation, strictly comply with legal provisions and follow judicial laws, adhere to justice for the people and fair justice, and adhere to "let those who adjudicate judge, and let those who judge be responsible." Efforts should be made to solve prominent problems in the reform of the judicial responsibility system, such as unclear functional division, unreal adjudicative responsibility, weak supervision and management, inconsistent adjudication standards, insufficient guarantees and incentives, and imperfect supporting mechanisms. A trial power operation system with clear rights and responsibilities, unified rights and responsibilities, strong supervision, and orderly operation should be improved and perfected, continuously enhancing the systematic nature, integrity, and coordination of the reform of the judicial responsibility system, ensuring that the reform is implemented and achieves practical results.

II. Improve the New-Type Trial Power Operation Mechanism and Effectively Implement the Requirement of "Let Those Who Adjudicate Judge"

3. Adhere to dual responsibilities for one position and consistent rights and responsibilities. Strengthen the construction of grassroots Party organizations in courts, focusing on enhancing organizational strength and strengthening political functions, deeply promote the organizational strength enhancement project of grassroots party organizations in people's courts, adjust and optimize the setting of grassroots party organizations, strengthen the standardization and normalization construction of party branches, and effectively build grassroots party organizations into strong combat fortresses that promote the reform and development of people's courts. Adhere to the principle of grasping party building to lead team building and promote adjudication, effectively strengthen the political construction and business construction of adjudication execution institutions and adjudication execution teams, improve and perfect the party and league organizations of adjudication execution teams, and enhance the organizational strength and combat effectiveness of the teams. Leading cadres at all levels of people's courts should take the lead in strictly implementing the main responsibilities, fully respect the legal trial organization status of single-judge tribunals and collegiate benches, except for cases decided by the adjudication committee, presidents, vice presidents, and division chiefs shall no longer review and sign judgment documents for cases in which they did not directly participate in the trial, shall not use oral instructions or other methods to indirectly approve cases, and shall not violate regulations to require judges to report on cases. Strictly implement the Implementation Measures of the People's Courts for the Provisions on the Recording, Notification, and Accountability of Leading Cadres Interfering in Judicial Activities and Intervening in Specific Case Handling and the Implementation Measures of the People's Courts for the Provisions on the Recording and Accountability of Internal Judicial Personnel Inquiring About Cases. Judges shall truthfully record inquiries about and interference in cases on the online case handling system and report them level by level to the superior people's court.

4. Strengthen the construction of adjudication teams in grassroots people's courts. Grassroots people's courts shall flexibly establish adjudication teams tailored to local conditions based on factors such as case volume, case types, difficulty levels, and personnel structure, adapting to the different needs of single-judge and collegiate bench systems, and taking into account the separation of complicated and simple cases and professional division of adjudication. The assignment of judges and adjudicative auxiliary personnel to adjudication teams shall combine two-way selection with organizational allocation. Improve the division of labor within the team, strengthen the function of the adjudication team as a case-handling unit and a self-management unit, and effectively enhance the team's cohesiveness. Coordinate the reform of internal institutions with the construction of adjudication teams. Grassroots people's courts with fewer personnel may set up comprehensive adjudication divisions or not set up adjudication divisions, implementing a "court-comprehensive adjudication division" or "court-adjudication team" management model. Grassroots people's courts with more personnel generally implement a "court-adjudication division-adjudication team" management model.

5. Clarify the job responsibilities of judicial personnel. People's courts at all levels shall, based on legal provisions and the requirements of the judicial responsibility system, and in light of actual conditions such as the court's trial level, case types, and case volume, refine the responsibility lists and performance guidelines for each position, including judges, judge assistants, and court clerks, and embed them into the case handling platform.

6. Improve the case assignment mechanism. People's courts at all levels shall improve the case assignment mechanism with random assignment as the main method and designated assignment as a supplement. According to the categories of trial fields and arrangements for the separation of complicated and simple cases, randomly determine the presiding judge for the case. Series, group, or related cases shall in principle be handled by the same trial organization. Where professional collegiate benches, professional adjudication teams, or expedited adjudication teams have been established, cases may be randomly assigned within the collegiate bench or adjudication team. Once the presiding judge is determined, it shall not be changed without authorization. Where a change of the presiding judge is truly necessary due to reasons such as recusal, job transfer, health condition, or integrity risk, the president or division chief shall make the decision upon approval according to authority, and the result of the change shall be promptly notified to the parties and recorded on the case handling platform.

7. Comprehensively promote the normalization of case handling by presidents and division chiefs. Each Higher People's Court shall, in light of actual conditions, scientifically and reasonably uniformly determine the case handling workload for presidents and division chiefs at the three levels of courts within its jurisdiction. The case handling workload of court leadership may be calculated based on the average case handling workload of judges in the court or the average case handling workload of judges in the trial business category to which the case belongs. Scientifically coordinate the types of cases handled by court leadership, improve supporting case assignment methods, and improve the mechanism for court leadership to mainly adjudicate major, difficult, and complex cases. Strengthen online disclosure and assessment supervision of case handling by presidents and division chiefs, fully leveraging the demonstration and leading role of case handling by presidents and division chiefs. Judges holding leadership positions who, without justifiable reasons, do not handle cases or fail to meet case handling requirements shall withdraw from the judge quota.

8. Improve the system of professional judge meetings and the adjudication committee system. People's courts at all levels shall improve the system of professional judge meetings, effectively leveraging the functions of professional judge meetings in unifying the application of law and providing legal consultation to trial organizations. Membership in professional judge meetings shall not require a position or rank as a necessary condition; all participants have equal status. Improve the pre-meeting preparation procedures and议事规则 of professional judge meetings, improve supporting assessment mechanisms, and enhance the quality of professional judge meetings.

Improve the work衔接 mechanism between professional judge meetings, collegiate bench deliberations, and adjudication committee discussions. Where a judgment may form a new adjudication standard or change the adjudication standard of similar effective cases from a superior people's court or the same court, it shall be submitted to a professional judge meeting or the adjudication committee for discussion. Where a collegiate bench does not adopt the unanimous opinion or majority opinion of a professional judge meeting, it shall mark and explain the reasons on the case handling system, and request supervision from the division chief or president. If the division chief or president deems it necessary to submit the case to the adjudication committee for discussion, the case shall be submitted to the adjudication committee for discussion according to procedures. Except for circumstances where the law provides that disclosure is not appropriate, the decisions and reasons of the adjudication committee for discussing cases shall be disclosed in the judgment documents.

9. Improve and perfect the mechanism for unified application of law. People's courts at all levels shall, on the basis of improving working mechanisms such as reference to similar cases and adjudication guidance, establish a mandatory retrieval mechanism for similar cases and related cases to ensure uniform adjudication standards for similar cases and unified application of law. For cases where there is a dispute over the application of law or the possibility of "different judgments for similar cases," the presiding judge shall prepare a retrieval report on related cases and similar cases and explain it during collegiate bench deliberations or professional judge meeting discussions.

10. Effectively reduce the burden of transactional work in adjudication. Adjudicative auxiliary affairs may be managed intensively, and work teams specializing in document service, property preservation, execution investigation and control, document online publication, and online announcements may be established to enhance work efficiency. Fully utilize market-based and socialized resources, explore outsourcing auxiliary affairs such as notice service, document scanning, and file archiving to third-party institutions, and entrust auxiliary affairs such as assisting preservation and execution service to relevant institutions to improve case handling efficiency.

III. Improve the New-Type Supervision and Management Mechanism and Disciplinary System, Effectively Implementing the Requirement of "Let Those Who Judge Be Responsible"

11. Improve the informatized full-process trial supervision and management mechanism. Fully support online case handling, full-process recording, and intelligent management. Provide intelligent early warning and monitoring of deviations in the trial process and results, promoting the transformation of trial supervision and management from monitoring individuals and cases and hierarchical approval to real-time dynamic supervision of the entire court, all personnel, and the full process, ensuring the unity of delegating power and supervision.

12. Strengthen the standardization and normalization construction of trial and execution work. Improve trial and execution process standards in areas such as criminal, civil, administrative, state compensation, and execution. Promote the deep integration of standardization and normalization construction with informatization construction. Incorporate every node from case filing, case assignment, service, trial, deliberation, pronouncement, execution to case closure and archiving into the scope of trial supervision and management. Strictly implement trial period management. Embed supervision matters into the case handling platform, achieving full-process recording of judicial activities, automatic interception of illegal operations, and real-time prompting of case handling risks.

13. Refine and implement the list of powers and responsibilities for trial supervision and management of presidents and division chiefs. The trial supervision and management powers and duties of presidents and division chiefs generally include: (1) allocating trial resources, including the establishment mode of professional collegiate benches and adjudication teams and their division of responsibilities; (2) deploying comprehensive work, including the arrangement and deployment of trial work, and the assignment and adjustment of trial or research tasks; (3) approving procedural matters, including approval of procedural matters authorized by law, adjusting case assignments according to regulations, and approving changes to trial organization members; (4) supervising trial quality and efficiency, including inspecting and supervising the trial process according to authority, inspecting, analyzing, and evaluating overall case quality and efficiency, analyzing trial operation trends, prompting correction of improper behavior, urging case hearing progress, coordinating and arranging rectification measures, and conducting centralized research and judgment on existing case quality issues; (5) supervising the "four types of cases," carrying out individual case supervision over the "four types of cases" specified in Article 24 of the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Improving the Judicial Responsibility System of People's Courts; (6) providing professional guidance, strengthening professional guidance by hearing cases, participating in professional judge meetings or adjudication committee meetings, etc.; (7) making comprehensive evaluations, on the basis of objective evaluation by the judge assessment committee relying on the informatization platform of judges' trial performance, making comprehensive evaluations of the performance of judges and other staff; (8) inspecting and supervising discipline and work style, identifying potential problems in case hearing by receiving visitor visits, handling complaints and reports, and daily supervision and management, and proposing improvement measures. People's courts at all levels shall, based on legal provisions and the requirements of the judicial responsibility system, respectively formulate lists of powers and responsibilities for trial supervision and management for presidents, vice presidents, full-time members of the adjudication committee, division chiefs, and deputy division chiefs. Where presidents and division chiefs perform supervision and management duties within the scope of the list of powers and responsibilities according to procedures, it does not constitute improper inquiry or interference in cases. Where presidents or division chiefs fail to perform or are negligent in performing their supervision and management duties, they shall bear supervision and management responsibility.

14. Further improve the identification and supervision system for the "four types of cases." Each Higher People's Court shall refine the scope of supervision, detection mechanism, initiation procedures, and supervision methods for the "four types of cases." The case filing department is responsible for preliminary identification of cases involving group disputes or that may affect social stability. Where the presiding judge discovers during the case hearing that a case falls within the scope of the "four types of cases," they shall proactively report to the division chief or the vice president in charge. Where the presiding judge believes that a case falls within the scope of the "four types of cases," they shall remind the presiding judge to proactively bring the case under supervision and management. Where the trial management institution or disciplinary inspection department, upon review, discovers that a case falls within the scope of the "four types of cases," they shall promptly report to the president. Explore automated identification and intelligent supervision of the "four types of cases." Where a judge fails to report as required, or where the president or division chief requires submission to a professional judge meeting or the adjudication committee for discussion but it is not submitted, the trial management system shall automatically issue an alert and remind the president or division chief to supervise. In supervising the "four types of cases," presidents and division chiefs may review case files, observe trials, view case process information, require the single-judge tribunal or collegiate bench to report case progress and deliberation results within a specified period, and provide judgment documents or retrieval reports for similar cases. When exercising the above trial supervision and management powers, presidents and division chiefs shall mark them on the case handling platform and maintain full-process records. If they have objections to the proposed adjudication results of the single-judge tribunal or collegiate bench, they may decide to submit the case to a professional judge meeting or the adjudication committee for discussion. They shall not force the single-judge tribunal or collegiate bench to accept their own opinions or directly change the opinions of the single-judge tribunal or collegiate bench.

15. Strengthen case quality evaluation. Adhere to the combination of routine random evaluation, key evaluation, and special evaluation of cases. Focus on evaluating cases that are remanded for retrial, reversed, involve petitions, or were previously under supervision for being prolonged outstanding cases or cases with prolonged detention without judgment. Rely on the informatization platform to conduct quality evaluations of published online judgment documents and open trials. The scope of quality evaluation shall cover all judges, comprehensively enhancing judges' sense of responsibility. Focus on discovering clues to illegal adjudication from case evaluations and investigate them according to relevant procedures. Strictly distinguish between liability for trial quality defects and liability for illegal adjudication, ensuring that judges who adjudicate according to law are not held accountable, but those who illegally adjudicate must be held accountable.

16. Strictly implement the accountability system for illegal adjudication. People's courts at all levels shall seriously investigate cases where judges are suspected of violating adjudication duties. The judge disciplinary committee shall, based on the investigation, review and determine whether the judge has violated adjudication duties, whether there is intent or gross negligence, and issue a review opinion. The relevant court shall make a disciplinary decision based on the opinion of the judge disciplinary committee. Where a judge's violation of adjudication duties is suspected of constituting a crime, it shall be transferred to the disciplinary inspection agency or procuratorial authority for handling according to law. Other disciplinary violations by judges beyond their adjudication duties shall be investigated by the relevant departments and handled according to law and relevant regulations.

17. Improve the judicial integrity risk prevention and control system. People's courts at all levels shall earnestly implement the main responsibility and supervisory responsibility for party conduct and integrity construction, consciously accept disciplinary supervision, legal supervision, public opinion supervision, and social supervision, and continuously improve the level of fair adjudication. Internally, people's courts at all levels shall fully leverage the functions and roles of judicial inspections, judicial affairs supervision, and integrity supervision officers. Organizational personnel, disciplinary inspection, trial management departments, and trial business departments shall strengthen coordination and cooperation to form an internal supervision synergy. Comprehensively sort out key nodes such as case handling processes and trial period management, analyze and study the possible case handling risks at each node, strengthen intelligent early warning of risk monitoring in trial and execution activities, and promote early detection, early warning, and early handling of judicial integrity risks.

IV. Coordinate the Promotion of Supporting Reforms for the Judicial Responsibility System, Enhancing the Overall Effectiveness of the Judicial Responsibility System Reform

18. Coordinate the promotion of the rational allocation of judge quotas and political and legal staffing. Each Higher People's Court shall strictly control the proportion of judge quotas, taking into account factors such as regional economic and social development, population size, and case volume, improve the dynamic management mechanism for judge quotas, and allocate quotas favoring grassroots courts and courts where the contradiction between personnel and cases is prominent. Each Higher People's Court shall, in coordination with the provincial staffing department, improve and perfect the unified management system for court staffing below the provincial level, strengthen the analysis of trial operation trends, strengthen scientific estimation of judges' workload, and take into account factors such as the number, types, difficulty levels, growth rates of cases in each city (district, county) court, as well as the area of jurisdiction, population size, natural conditions, development status, and number of people's courts, accurately analyze and estimate the political and legal staffing required for each city (district, county) court, and allocate staffing toward courts with shortages and urgent needs, achieving a reasonable match among staffing, case volume, and personnel.

19. Improve the mechanism for exiting the judge quota. Each Higher People's Court shall, for different circumstances such as substandard trial performance, resignation, dismissal, expulsion, disciplinary violations, withdrawal due to avoidance, transfer out, change of position, retirement, and personal application for withdrawal, standardize the procedures for exiting the quota, and clarify the issues of rank and treatment for those who exit the quota but remain in the court. People's courts at all levels shall guarantee judges' rights to make statements, present evidence, defend themselves, and apply for reconsideration regarding the exit decision. Where a quota judge, due to work needs, is transferred to a non-quota position in the court and returns to a trial business position in a grassroots or intermediate people's court within five years, the case shall be submitted to the Higher People's Court for approval to enter the quota after review by the party group of the court where the judge is located. Where the judge returns to a trial business position in a higher people's court or the Supreme People's Court within five years, the decision to enter the quota shall be made respectively by the party group of the court.

20. Further improve the system for initial appointment and gradual selection of judges. Improve and perfect the mechanism for selecting judges from outstanding judge assistants, and establish a scientifically complete pre-appointment training system for first-instance judges. Where conditions permit, cross-court selection may be carried out to guide trial forces toward courts where the contradiction between personnel and cases is prominent.

21. Strengthen the deployment and training of judge assistants and clerks. Establish and improve a recruitment mechanism for judge assistants that aligns with the characteristics of the judicial profession, and improve the unified recruitment and support mechanism for judge assistants. Promote the normalization of law school students serving as intern judge assistants, and explore a system for judges of lower people's courts to exchange and serve as short-term assistants in higher people's courts, thereby broadening the sources of judge assistants through multiple channels. Actively study and establish a reserve talent training system for judges, meticulously implement the reform of the professional rank sequence for judge assistants and clerks, innovate and improve the training model for judge assistants, and judge assistants who meet the relevant conditions may apply to participate in judge selection. All higher people's courts shall actively seek support from human resources and social security, financial, and other departments, strengthen the recruitment of contract-based clerks, implement the reform of the management system for contract-based clerks, and effectively stabilize the team of contract-based clerks.

22. Improve the performance assessment system for judicial personnel. Adhere to a combination of objective quantification and subjective evaluation, with quantitative assessment as the primary method. Fully consider differences in regions, trial levels, specialties, and departments. Emphasize the use of scientific calculation methods such as weight measurement, and reasonably set weight ratios. In places where conditions for calculating case weight coefficients are temporarily not available, explore simple and feasible methods for converting case workload. Incorporate into performance assessment the workload of judges when serving as other members of a collegial panel, the workload of handling litigation-related petition cases, the workload of participating in professional judge meetings and the judicial committee, and the workload of case evaluation. Based on the different functions assumed by each people's court, scientifically set the content of performance assessment for judicial personnel. For the performance assessment of judges and judge assistants, consideration shall be given to the workload of comprehensive research, trial guidance, and other tasks, avoiding simply using the number of cases handled as the basis for performance evaluation. For the performance assessment of trial support personnel, the basic basis shall be their job responsibilities and the work they undertake, with emphasis on combining with the performance of their team, and listening to the opinions of judges and the team. The distribution of performance appraisal bonuses shall not be linked to the professional rank of judges or the positions of trial support personnel, but shall primarily be based on factors such as the weight of responsibility, case handling quality, case handling quantity, and case difficulty, with preference given to frontline case handling personnel.

23. Further deepen judicial transparency. Strictly implement the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Publication of Judgment Documents on the Internet by People's Courts," continuously improve the informatization and normalization level of the publication of judgment documents, and ensure that all judgment documents that should be published are published comprehensively, timely, and accurately. Actively promote the use of automatic error correction and technical processing software for judgment documents, strive to eliminate all types of low-level errors and quality defects, effectively reduce the workload of publishing judgment documents, and continuously improve the level of publication of judgment documents. All people's courts shall effectively implement the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Disclosure of Trial Process Information on the Internet by People's Courts," promptly upgrade and improve relevant informatization platforms, actively connect to the unified national platform for the disclosure of trial process information, and effectively implement all requirements for the disclosure of trial process information. Actively adapt to the new requirements for open court hearings in the Internet era, effectively leverage the advantages of the unified platform of the China Open Court Hearings Website, and continuously deepen the work of open court hearings in people's courts.

All people's courts shall fully understand the significant importance of comprehensively implementing the judicial accountability system, effectively strengthen organizational leadership, closely integrate with actual work, and earnestly implement this implementation opinion. Further improve the reform supervision mechanism, maintain close attention and dynamic tracking of the comprehensive implementation of the judicial accountability system. Major issues arising during the implementation of this implementation opinion shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court in accordance with the procedures.
